_comment: Static IP -> zone/host map for the lab. Every simulated 'host' in the topology binds its lab client sockets to a distinct 127.0.0.x loopback address (Linux allows binding to any address in 127.0.0.0/8 without extra network setup), so a single-machine run of this lab still has real, distinguishable source identities for the detection engine to reason about -- see docs/architecture.md for why this substitutes for separate Docker containers in constrained environments. The docker-compose.yml topology assigns real container IPs on a dedicated bridge network instead, and this file's zone semantics carry over unchanged.
